title: Oscar and the Will
author: Dominic Okafor
blurb: Ada Yarrow, an insurance investigator with a photographic memory, thought they had seen every way a life can end. Then twin letters arrive: one confessing, one promising more — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must close the one case everyone swore was closed for good, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
